review_method: Inspected actual PNG pixels from stable copies after validating each PNG SHA-256 against the final render receipt, which identifies fresh import of the frozen GLB. No retouching.

views.name: front_threequarter
views.finding: Anonymous compact silhouette, paired side-door handles, pillars, wheel arches, wipers and lamps read clearly. No glazing leaks or detached wheel appearance. Thin seam visibility varies.

views.name: rear_threequarter
views.finding: Rear fascia and opaque cabin read coherently; rear-deck shutline is faint/intermittent. No open shell or wheel-contact defect visible.

views.name: front
views.finding: Full frontal body and both front tire contacts visible; closed opaque glazing. Minor bright pinched/faceted lower-valance highlights remain.

views.name: rear
views.finding: Full rear body and tire contacts visible; rear screen opaque, lamps/blank panel legible. Faint deck line and minor low-poly lower-valance shading remain.

views.name: side
views.finding: Full side silhouette shows two doors, A/B/C pillars, fuel flap, arch clearance and both near-side tire contacts. Upper door transitions have thin angle-dependent seam visibility.

views.name: eye_level
views.finding: Near-ground three-quarter view shows a coherent parked stance and no visible wheel/body clipping; opposite wheel visible under front fascia. Opaque glass treatment holds.

views.name: underside
views.finding: Closed simple underfloor and black undertray visible. No major open shell or absent wheel surface seen. Intentionally simplified underside has no mechanical-completeness claim.

views.name: wheel_contact
views.finding: Close-up confirms tread meets the review ground and a visible gap remains to the arch. Wheel-cover vent slots are uneven and partly occluded by the dish; this is a cosmetic close-up limitation.

views.name: top
views.finding: Corrected framing includes the entire overhead silhouette and both bumper tips. Roof, A/B/C pillars, mirrors, hood/deck contours, wipers and opaque screens inspected; no newly visible geometry defect.

visual_caveats: Faint/intermittent thin rear-deck shutline and angle-dependent thin seam visibility.
Minor pinched/faceted lower-valance highlights in frontal lighting.
Wheel-cover vent slots are uneven and partly occluded by the dish in close-up; the openings are not uniformly clean.
coverage_note: Corrected top preview at 6.7 m orthographic width includes both bumper tips and the full overhead silhouette; all nine views have been visually reviewed.
